"""Reports CSV exporter."""

import csv
import io


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Return CSV text ..."""
    names = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for name in names:
        if not isinstance(name, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if name in seen:
            raise ValueError("column names must be unique")
        seen.add(name)

    buf = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(buf, delimiter=",", lineterminator="\r\n", quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, doublequote=True)
    writer.writerow(names)
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow(["" if (value := row.get(name, "")) is None else str(value) for name in names])
    return buf.getvalue()
